evidence: criteria_routing.json T11 checklist key 'rollback_no_data_loss': 'There is a back-out path and no data loss on partial failure.' — this is the JSON-serialized form of the POST-ROLLBACK check
Plan Scope: 'src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T11.md, tests/unit/test_plan_review_t11_rubric.py … docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md' — criteria_routing.json is absent
